description: VYBE Music v4.2.0 - Complete YouTube Playlist Import (Zero Missing Songs), Instant Playback for Imported Songs, Protected Playlist Sync, Total Listening Hours & Installed Days in Library, and Spotify Matching Fallback.
changelog: Full YouTube Playlist Import: Imported playlists now fetch all pages with zero missing songs
Instant Playback for Imported Songs: Songs from imported playlists now start immediately without playback errors
YouTube Radio & Mix Continuations: Added seamless /next pagination for dynamic YouTube radio queues
Protected Local Playlists: Fixed bug where playlists were wiped if remote sync returned empty or dynamic radio was refreshed
Listening Stats in Library: In place of Recap, library now displays total listening hours and days since the app was installed
Spotify Search Matching Fallback: Added automatic broad search fallback to maximize song matching accuracy when importing Spotify tracks
Direct Library Navigation: Importing a playlist now takes you directly to your ready-to-play library playlist
